decision_record.calculation: Filter fixture: 5Min series ending 14:55Z judged at 18:00Z (close age ~2.9h > 4x300s) -> entry refused; series ending 17:55Z -> passes; an exit intent on the stale view passes untouched.
decision_record.comparison: Pre-change rule: the sleeve's time gate reads the BAR's timestamp (time_gate_ok on the episode's entry_t), never the decision clock — a stale feed's in-window bar passes every gate.
decision_record.experiment: Filter-level A/B (the gate is the unit under test; entry production is oracle-covered by the port suite): stale/fresh/exit cases above.
decision_record.mechanism: Execution freshness: span-adaptive stale-bar gate on the served 5Min series (newest close > 4 spans old -> refuse entries; exits never gated).
decision_record.transfer: The box-break entry is a claim on the CURRENT hour's first bar out of a frozen box. On a dead 5-minute feed, the 'first bar out' is a print from hours ago; the box, the EMA21 gate and the entry-hour gate are all evaluated on that corpse.

switch: extra.bilbo_options_enh2.stale_bar_gate default ON; OFF restores the pre-change rule exactly
